card.title: Nintendo Switch Draws 0.4a - 0.6a from charger but does not turn on Repair

source.title: Nintendo Switch Draws 0.4a - 0.6a from charger but does not turn on Repair

symptoms: draws 0.4-0.6 A from charger but won't turn on

claims.statement: A Switch drawing 0.4–0.6 A on the charger but not turning on: make sure the eMMC is plugged in; otherwise suspect PI3USB.

card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
